Gideon's 1 Jul message in #strategic-pod says he closed ticket #8841 with support that morning. The fix he described was that the customer's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing dept.

The records don't agree on what #8841 was. Ruth's April email and Moss's May digest put it at the Allentron gate kiosk or gate log (Door 12 to 18), and Moss's 30 Sep digest puts it at Newark, where drivers couldn't select Door 14. None of the records show the cache fix or a closing note, so check the support ticket before relying on this. I posted this in #strategic-pod, replying to you.
